title: Degree-zero cohomology and the degree-zero pullback map
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $G$ an abelian sheaf on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $H^q(T_{\Et},G)$ be the cohomology of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], computed from a K-injective resolution $s:G\to I^\bullet$ [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions].

1. (Degree zero.) The map $\epsilon_{T,G}:G(T)\to\mathcal H^0(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet))=H^0(T_{\Et},G)$, $g\mapsto$ the class of $s(g)\in I^0(T)$, is well defined (it lands in the degree-$0$ cocycles) and is an isomorphism of abelian groups. It is natural in $G$ (for $\varphi:G\to G'$, $H^0(\varphi)\circ\epsilon_{T,G}=\epsilon_{T,G'}\circ\varphi(T)$, with $H^0(\varphi)$ as in [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]) and compatible with the identifications between different choices of $I^\bullet$ [prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent].
2. (Pullback in degree zero.) Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes, $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$, $u^{-1}$ the inverse image with unit $\eta_u:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and $u^*:H^0(X_{\Et},G)\to H^0(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)$ the pullback map of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] in degree $0$. Then
$$u^*\circ\epsilon_{X,G}=\epsilon_{Y,u^{-1}G}\circ\eta_{u,G}(X),$$
where $\eta_{u,G}(X):G(X)\to(u_*u^{-1}G)(X)=(u^{-1}G)(Y)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is the unit on global sections. In words: under $H^0=\Gamma$ the degree-zero pullback map is "pull back the global section".

proof.text: *$\epsilon$ is well defined for every K-injective resolution.* View $G$ as the complex $G[0]$ concentrated in degree $0$; a K-injective resolution $s:G\to I^\bullet$ [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions] is a morphism of complexes $G[0]\to I^\bullet$, so $d^0_I\circ s^0=s^1\circ d^0_{G[0]}=0$ since $G[0]^1=0$. Evaluating at the final object $T$: for $g\in G(T)$, $s^0_T(g)\in I^0(T)=\Gamma(T,I^0)$ satisfies $d^0(s^0_T(g))=0$, i.e. lies in the degree-$0$ cycles of $\Gamma(T,I^\bullet)$, and $\epsilon_{T,G}=\epsilon_s$ is the composite of the homomorphism $s^0_T:G(T)\to Z^0(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet))$ with the projection to $\mathcal H^0(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet))=H^0(T_{\Et},G)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]; it is a homomorphism of abelian groups. (No hypothesis $I^q=0$ for $q<0$ is used; we write $\epsilon_s$ when the resolution matters.)

proof.text:
*Naturality, and compatibility with the identifications (any K-injective resolutions).* Let $\varphi:G\to G'$ be a morphism of abelian sheaves on $T_{\Et}$, $s:G\to I^\bullet$, $s':G'\to I'^\bullet$ K-injective resolutions, and $\tilde\varphi:I^\bullet\to I'^\bullet$ a morphism of complexes with $\tilde\varphi\circ s\simeq s'\circ\varphi$ as morphisms $G[0]\to I'^\bullet$; such lifts exist, and $H^q(\varphi)=\mathcal H^q(\Gamma(T,\tilde\varphi))$ does not depend on the lift [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] (statement and step 1(a),(b)). A homotopy between two morphisms $G[0]\to I'^\bullet$ consists of $h^n:G[0]^n\to I'^{n-1}$; only $h^0:G\to I'^{-1}$ can be nonzero, and the homotopy identity in degree $0$ reads $\tilde\varphi^0s^0-s'^0\varphi=d^{-1}_{I'}h^0+h^1d^0_{G[0]}=d^{-1}_{I'}h^0$. Evaluating at $T$, for $g\in G(T)$: $\tilde\varphi^0_T(s^0_T(g))-s'^0_T(\varphi_T(g))=d^{-1}(h^0_T(g))$ is a coboundary of $\Gamma(T,I'^\bullet)$ (note: $I'^{-1}$ may be nonzero; this is the only place negative terms occur, and they only contribute coboundaries). Hence in $\mathcal H^0(\Gamma(T,I'^\bullet))$: $\mathcal H^0(\Gamma(T,\tilde\varphi))(\epsilon_s(g))=\epsilon_{s'}(\varphi_T(g))$, i.e. $H^0(\varphi)\circ\epsilon_{T,G}=\epsilon_{T,G'}\circ\varphi(T)$, the naturality of clause (1). For $G'=G$, $\varphi=\mathrm{id}_G$ and two K-injective resolutions $s,s'$ of $G$ this gives $\epsilon_{s'}=H^0(\mathrm{id}_G)\circ\epsilon_s$, where $H^0(\mathrm{id}_G):\mathcal H^0(\Gamma(T,I^\bullet))\to\mathcal H^0(\Gamma(T,I'^\bullet))$ is the identification of [prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent] ([lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial], step 1(b)): $\epsilon$ is compatible with the identifications between resolutions.
Lean implementation of the naturality assertion: let F = Gamma(T,-), M = F.mapHomologicalComplex, and K = M(G[0]). The image of the inverse of singleObjXSelf lifts to w : F(G) -> K.cycles(0), since the differential of G[0] is zero. Cancel the monomorphism iCycles to identify w followed by cyclesMap(M(s)) with z, and w followed by cyclesMap(M(single(phi) composed with s')) with F(phi) followed by z'. Apply F.mapHomotopy to the supplied homotopy h and then Homotopy.homologyMap_eq. Precompose with w followed by K.homologyπ(0), and use homologyπ_naturality and homologyMap_comp to obtain the required equality. This proof of the asserted equality needs no additional comparison-existence lemma, because a and h are hypotheses of the Lean statement.

proof.text: For the cycle factor z constructed in step 1, apply lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero-iso-factor with the factorization equality hz. This proves that z followed by the degree-zero homology projection is an isomorphism for the given K-injective resolution, including resolutions with negative terms.

*Clause (2): the degree-zero pullback map.* Let $s:G\to I^\bullet$ and $r:u^{-1}I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ be the K-injective resolutions defining $u^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], so that $H^0(X_{\Et},G)$ is computed from $s$ and $H^0(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)$ from the K-injective resolution $t=r\circ u^{-1}(s):u^{-1}G\to J^\bullet$ (as that definition says), and in degree $0$, $u^*$ sends the class of a cycle $a\in I^0(X)$ to the class of $r^0_Y(\eta_{u,I^0}(X)(a))\in J^0(Y)$, with $\eta_{u,I^0}(X)(a)\in(u_*u^{-1}I^0)(X)=(u^{-1}I^0)(Y)$. Take $\epsilon_{X,G}=\epsilon_s$ and $\epsilon_{Y,u^{-1}G}=\epsilon_t$ (for other choices both sides change by the identifications, by step 2 and clause 1 of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]). The unit $\eta_u:\mathrm{id}\to u_*u^{-1}$ is a natural transformation [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]; for the morphism $s^0:G\to I^0$ this says $\eta_{u,I^0}\circ s^0=u_*u^{-1}(s^0)\circ\eta_{u,G}$. Evaluate at the object $X$ of $X_{\Et}$: since $(u_*\alpha)_X=\alpha_{X\times_XY}=\alpha_Y$ for a morphism $\alpha$ of sheaves on $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], for $g\in G(X)$ we get $\eta_{u,I^0}(X)(s^0_X(g))=(u^{-1}s^0)_Y(\eta_{u,G}(X)(g))$. Applying $r^0_Y$: $u^*(\epsilon_{X,G}(g))$ is the class of $r^0_Y(\eta_{u,I^0}(X)(s^0_X(g)))=(r^0\circ u^{-1}(s^0))_Y(\eta_{u,G}(X)(g))=t^0_Y(\eta_{u,G}(X)(g))$, which is $\epsilon_t(\eta_{u,G}(X)(g))$ (step 1). Hence $u^*\circ\epsilon_{X,G}=\epsilon_{Y,u^{-1}G}\circ\eta_{u,G}(X)$.
Lean implementation: package the unit and the pushforward/global-sections identification as a natural transformation eta : Gamma_X -> upperStar composed with Gamma_Y. Its component at G is globalSectionsUpperStarMap, by naturality of GammaNatIsoSheafSections and the definition of lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso. Rewrite homologyπ_naturality and cancel the target iCycles to reduce the resolution formula to eta.naturality at singleObjXSelf.inv composed with s.f(0), followed by Gamma_Y(r.f(0)). For the Ext encoding, unfold H.equiv₀, mapExactFunctor_mk₀, and mk₀_comp_mk₀. The constant-sheaf comparison is leftAdjointUniq between the composite constant-sheaf/pullback adjunction (transported on the right by the terminal-sections isomorphism) and the target constant-sheaf adjunction. homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies precomposition by its inverse with the composite adjunction homEquiv. Unit naturality identifies this with the unit on sections. The naturality of the equivalence Hom(ULift Z,-) with underlying elements and cancellation of GammaNatIsoSheafSections finish the pointwise formula.

split_report.summary: Option (a) of the brief: clause 1 is proved for one bounded below injective resolution and transported to every K-injective resolution. Step 1: s(g) is a degree-0 cycle for any K-injective s (elementary). Step 2: for a lift phi~ of phi with phi~ s homotopic to s' phi, the homotopy G[0] -> I'^{-1} makes the difference a coboundary, giving naturality and compatibility with the identifications for arbitrary (unbounded) K-injective resolutions. Step 3: Gamma(T,-) is left exact (kernels sectionwise, def-pur-abelian-sheaf-kernel), Ab(T_et) has enough injectives; the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero (InjectiveResolution.of, instIsIsoToRightDerivedZero') gives an injective resolution with I^q=0 for q<0, K-injective by lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative (2), for which epsilon is bijective. Step 4: epsilon_s = H^0(id) o epsilon_{s0} with H^0(id) bijective (lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial step 1(b), prop-weil-pbc-cohomology-resolution-independent). Step 5: clause 2 from the naturality of the unit at s^0 evaluated at X and u_*alpha(X)=alpha(Y), with epsilon_Y taken for r o u^{-1}s as def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback prescribes. Statement and stmt_deps unchanged. Mathlib searches added (three kinds): only the bounded below degree-zero fact is in Mathlib. Leaves: step 1 elementary; step 3 rests on a new Mathlib leaf; no unsplit node created. slopmaster2 has no declaration identifying Etale.cohomologyMap in degree 0 with globalSectionsUpperStarMap through Sheaf.H.equiv0.
